description: This file implements distributed lock management functions (AcquireLock, ReleaseLock, RenewLock, GetLockStatus) with support for both BoltDB and PostgreSQL backends, including specific PostgreSQL queries for lock operations.

classes.name: LocalStorage
classes.description: A struct that manages local storage and distributed lock operations, supporting multiple database modes.

methods.name: AcquireLock
methods.description: Attempts to acquire a distributed lock, delegating to PostgreSQL-specific implementation if mode is 'postgres'.

methods.name: ReleaseLock
methods.description: Releases a distributed lock, delegating to PostgreSQL-specific implementation if mode is 'postgres'.

methods.name: RenewLock
methods.description: Renews a distributed lock to extend its TTL, delegating to PostgreSQL-specific implementation if mode is 'postgres'.

methods.name: GetLockStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of a distributed lock, delegating to PostgreSQL-specific implementation if mode is 'postgres'.

methods.name: acquireLockPostgres
methods.description: PostgreSQL-specific method to acquire a distributed lock with SQL insert/update logic.

methods.name: releaseLockPostgres
methods.description: PostgreSQL-specific method to release a lock by deleting its record.

methods.name: renewLockPostgres
methods.description: PostgreSQL-specific method to renew a lock by updating its expiration time.

methods.name: getLockStatusPostgres
methods.description: PostgreSQL-specific method to retrieve lock status by key.
